findings.name: commit-after-yield
findings.message: Session 'db' is committed after yield in dependency 'app.db.get_db'. On FastAPI >= 0.118 this runs after the response is sent.
findings.fix_hint: Commit explicitly in the route before returning, or use Depends(dep, scope='function').

findings.name: shared-session-concurrency
findings.message: Session 'db' passed to 3 coroutines in asyncio.gather().
findings.fix_hint: Give each concurrent task its own session.

findings.name: unsafe-background-work
findings.message: Request session 'db' passed to background task 'asyncio.create_task'. The session will be closed when the request ends.
findings.fix_hint: Open a new session inside the background task.

findings.name: unsafe-background-work
findings.message: Result of 'asyncio.create_task' (create_task/ensure_future) is not stored. The task may be garbage-collected before completing.

findings.name: lazy-relationship
findings.message: Async session loads 'order' (model app.models.Order) and reads relationship 'customer' without eager-load option. lazy=None.

findings.name: session-outlives-request
findings.message: Session 'session' stored on instance as 'self.session'. If this object is created at module level or cached, the session outlives any single request.
findings.fix_hint: Do not store sessions on instance attributes.

findings.name: session-outlives-request
findings.message: Session factory 'Catalog' called at module level ('catalog'). Module-level sessions outlive requests.
findings.fix_hint: Move session creation into a per-request dependency or route.

findings.name: helper-commits
findings.message: Helper 'app.services.checkout.reserve_stock' calls commit() on session 'db' which it received as a parameter.
findings.fix_hint: Use flush() in the helper; commit once in the owner.

findings.name: helper-commits
findings.message: Helper 'app.services.inventory.restock_product' calls commit() on session 'db' which it received as a parameter.
findings.fix_hint: Use flush() in the helper; commit once in the owner.

findings.name: begin-after-autobegin
findings.message: session.begin() called on 'db' which already has prior operations. SQLAlchemy autobegin is already active.
findings.fix_hint: Remove the explicit begin() - autobegin handles transaction start. Use begin_nested() for savepoints.
